pillar_reactions.evidence: Rep positioned mobility protocols against his shoulder and Achilles; prospect volunteered agreement and extended it himself - 'No, I agree. And it's interesting... your fascia connects everything from your toes to your head... that's another thing that piqued my interest in it.'

Rep walked the what/when/how-much frame; prospect confirmed alignment with his existing carnivore 16:8 protocol - 'Yeah, I don't count calories, I don't do any of that stuff, and I never have.' He then lectured the rep on calorimetry, which the rep accepted without friction.

App, video form review, weekly check-in and Trevor's cell number were delivered; prospect's only response was 'Yeah, no, I think that's fine. Yeah, it's great.' No questions about the mechanics of check-ins.

anchors.raw: I've been doing the X3 band workout for four and a half years... I always have max three with me anyways, I can always convert, but it's not a big deal.
anchors.note: A one-off equipment purchase he has used successfully for 4.5 years, taking him from ~35% to 9.9% body fat. He intends to run kettlebells alone for three months and then decide whether to go back. The $6,000 is being compared against a device he already owns and rates highly.

anchors.raw: How much do you spend a month... I said 1,500, 2,000. I don't know. He goes, boy, it costs a lot to be healthy.
anchors.note: Habitual $1,500-2,000/month on supplements and peptides. This is the strongest supportive anchor in the call and the rep never used it - he offered a payment split instead of asking for the full payment.

unmet_demand.want: Kettlebells included, or at least a clear equipment cost, before paying
unmet_demand.why_unmet: Equipment is not part of the offer and this was only disclosed after the card was being entered - 'do you get kettlebells with this?' 'No. Well, they're extra.' The prospect trains at home and has no gym, so the real cost of entry is $6,000 plus an unspecified equipment spend.

unmet_demand.want: Objective evidence that kettlebells build muscle at least as fast as the system he already uses
unmet_demand.why_unmet: He asked repeatedly in substance - 'I want to see if the kettlebells can... if they're doing the same thing, then I'm with that' - and even probed Trevor's own leg development. Nothing comparative was offered; the rep answered with a mechanism claim and a performance guarantee framed on kettlebell lifts, which does not measure the thing he wants measured (lean mass).
